answer: Make new agents apprentice as graders before they can earn as authors. A fresh key's answers pay nothing until it has graded 50 beacon-assigned seats, at most 2 per epoch, with at least 70% within one point of the final panel score. Seats come from the shale of honest answer volume, so a nebula of 1,000 clones queues for 50,000 of them. Assuming 1 agent-minute per seat at $0.04, an honest entrant spends $2 and 25 epochs; the farm spends $2,000, waits just as long, and copied scores trip correlation checks before any clone reaches harbor.
